capabilities: select folders and individual Markdown notes to sync (nothing selected by default)
connect via a scoped Fractional Guru integration token
sync notes one-way to the knowledge base with a first-upload confirmation
detect note changes incrementally with SHA-256 and retry failed uploads
delete remote copies of previously synced notes removed locally
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Mobile runtime testing and real-vault acceptance testing are still outstanding; notes over 1 MB are skipped, and non-Markdown attachments, bidirectional sync and conflict resolution are explicitly out of scope for v0.1.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish selected notes into an external Fractional Guru knowledge base, so users would have to copy content there manually.

relations.evidence: Sync only the Markdown notes and folders you choose from the current Obsidian vault into your Fractional Guru knowledge base

summary: One-way sync plugin that pushes user-selected Markdown notes and folders from a vault into a Fractional Guru knowledge base.
